task.description: rework for FAIL handoffs/M1SITE-20261119-01/step-02b-req-validator.json, gate pass 2 of 3 — WF-01, step 1 (rework step 01c): REQ-ANALYST reworks the two blocks REQ-111 (R1.2) and REQ-112 (R1.3) at the end of docs/requirements.yaml only by the findings N1-N8 of that handoff, closing each in the text or, where a finding is wrong, keeping the text and saying why in result.issues with evidence; what the gate did not question stays. The list of remarks (the findings of gate pass 2, with their fixes as the gate wrote them): N1 [medium] REQ-112 criterion 4 (the parenthesis of the page tokens of section 9.1 and «every marker is found back at least once»), REQ-112 fact (9) and the description sentence «draw.js draws … (figures, desks, monitors, plates, the door)» do not match the look description in the tree (docs/design/V1-public-look.md, sha256 2e3e2dbd…, rework 03c): its 9.1 reads the colours from the scene tokens of 6.2 and the page token --ink only, nothing derived while drawing, no --btn (the sample's accent #e0731f kept); its 6.2 has 24 colour tokens with values, one derivation rule (the alpha of 9.11) and leaves --sc-dim-alpha to the code design; no text is drawn on the canvas, the plates are DOM labels; so criterion 4 and criterion 8 cannot both hold (AP-016, AP-055) and fact (9) is false; fix — make criterion 4, fact (9) and the draw.js sentence read one version with the look: name the palette as the look gives it (the 6.2 scene tokens and --ink) and say how the alpha of the light layer is checked (from a given --sc-dim-alpha with the test computing the alphas from the closed lists of 9.11 with the look's rounding, or from the closed alpha lists per theme), or keep --btn, --onbtn and --acc2 and name the change 9.1 and 6.2 then need; route it with the look's alignment (step 03c issue I1 (b), (c)) and name in this handoff the hash of the look version it aligned to. N2 [low] REQ-111 criterion 11 («a fresh clone of depth 1 … (`git clone --depth 1`: the one commit that the checkouts of app.yml get)») and fact (14): a clone from a local path ignores --depth (measured: 181 commits, not shallow); with file:// it holds one commit; fix — name a form that holds one commit (`git clone --depth 1 file://<path>`, `--no-local`, or a clone from origin) and a check in the clone: `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` gives true and `git rev-list --count HEAD` gives 1. N3 [low] REQ-111 criterion 12, «no text element whose scrollWidth exceeds its clientWidth», says nothing about visibility: the .sr boxes (styles.css:19) and the stage that clips the 700-px canvas have scrollWidth above clientWidth on a page built to the look; fix — say which elements the rule reads (own visible text), or name the .sr elements and the clipping stage as outside it, or require a visually hidden form that keeps scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth. N4 [low] REQ-111 criterion 12 (the public-set sentence, «… and no console error») and criterion 13 («no console error, exception or …»): every load of a 404 page writes Chrome's «Failed to load resource … 404» line (decisions/0118 О2); fix — write «no console entry but the declared ones (decisions/0118 О2)» in both places. N5 [low] REQ-111 criterion 3, «a form of another language's list in a text of this language is not found»: «минут» is a form of list В in ru and kk; fix — write «a form that only another language's list has», or name «минут» as the one form two lists share. N6 [low] REQ-111 fact (4), «fails tsc … with 50 errors (TS7006; still 44 with server/vendor excluded while a file imports it)»: measured 50 errors (44 TS7006, 5 TS2339, 1 TS7053), and also 50 with server/vendor excluded, an importer and no declaration file; fix — correct the parenthesis. N7 [low] REQ-111 (guard row (8), criterion 11) against REQ-108 criterion 11 («paths exactly …» six entries; «the jobs are exactly check, pg and docker»): REQ-111 adds the job e2e and four paths and names REQ-109 criterion 8's replaced sentence for decision 0123 and the micro-amendment (question О3, AP-133), but not these two literals; fix — add REQ-108 criterion 11's job list and path list to question О3 (decisions/0123) and to a REQ-108 micro-amendment, as for REQ-109 criterion 8. N8 [low] REQ-111 criterion 10, the parenthesis «(a sketch … 27 planted lines red, 14 twins green …)»: the criterion lists 16 twins, the gate's sketch gave 29 planted lines red and 16 twins green; fix — give the count that matches the list, or drop it. result.summary: Rework of REQ-111 and REQ-112 by the eight findings N1-N8 of gate pass 2 only (step 02b), read and measured in the tree; every edit is in the two blocks or their comment lines, and the rest of docs/requirements.yaml is byte-equal (lines 1-15171 sha256 3fdee311…, equal to the tag). N1 (Medium, REQ-112): criterion 4 now gives draw.js the palette the look description names for the canvas — the 24 colour tokens of its 6.2, the page token --ink and the strength of the light layer as the number --sc-dim-alpha, with no --btn, --onbtn or --acc2 — and draw.js calls only fillRect and sets only fillStyle, with no text on the canvas; the test checks every fill against markers (a given colour, the light layer of the --sc-dim marker with an alpha computed exactly from a marker strength and the «What the bands keep» lists of 9.11 rounded half up to 4 decimals, or a constant of 6.2's list for the theme), finds every marker back, and with the real strengths .15 and .5 finds exactly the closed alpha lists of 9.11; fact (9) and the description's draw.js sentence say the same. It was aligned to the look of sha256 2e3e2dbd…5648 (step 03c); the look's own rework step 03e ran in parallel and closed at 15:28:59Z during this step, so fact (9) was re-measured and quoted from its final version 3dea2340…9347, which takes the same route (its 6.2, 9.1 and §14 name this palette and state the strength as --sc-dim-alpha). N2: criterion 11 names a clone form that holds one commit (`git clone --depth 1 file://<path>`, --no-local or the origin) and checks it is shallow with one commit; fact (14) names the form and the measured trap of a plain local path. N3: criterion 12's overflow rule reads only elements with their own visible text and leaves out the .sr elements; the stage holds no own text; a Chrome probe (fact 20) shows the rule holds on a page built to the look. N4: criteria 12 and 13 allow only the declared console entries (the 404 page's line, decisions/0118 О2). N5: criterion 3 says «a form that only another language's list has» and names «минут» as the one shared form (an exhaustive pass of 118 forms). N6: fact (4) gives the measured tsc errors (44 TS7006, 5 TS2339, 1 TS7053; the same 50 with vendor excluded and no declaration). N7: guard row (8) and the Bar name REQ-108 criterion 11's two literals for question О3 and a REQ-108 micro-amendment. N8: criterion 10 and fact (17) give the counts of my own sketch (22 forms, 16 twins). No criterion was weakened and no outcome changed. Beyond the list, raised as issues and not edited: REQ-112's frame sentence and criterion 5 against the look's new one-frame rule for a state change with no walk (I2), REQ-112 fact (10)'s twin count (I3), REQ-112 fact (7)'s clone form (I4); two wording points of the look (I8). Open questions for decisions/0123: О3 widened (I5) and the new О22 on the canvas palette (I6).
